services.name: eks-cluster
services.purpose: Managed Kubernetes control plane for running containerized microservices.

services.name: microservice-a
services.purpose: Application microservice A deployed as a container in the EKS cluster.

services.name: microservice-b
services.purpose: Application microservice B deployed as a container in the EKS cluster.

services.name: prometheus
services.purpose: Prometheus instance collecting metrics from the microservices.

services.name: grafana
services.purpose: Grafana dashboard visualizing metrics from Prometheus.

network.notes: Ingress is assumed to be handled by an AWS Application Load Balancer integrated with the EKS cluster.

ambiguities.detail: Assumed two microservices named microservice-a and microservice-b.
Assumed use of Amazon EKS as the managed Kubernetes service.
Assumed EFS for shared file storage and RDS for relational database.
Assumed microservices and Grafana need public internet access.
Assumed simple HTTPS ingress rules for public services.
ambiguities.assumption: Ingress will be configured via an ALB.

ambiguities.detail: Assumed Prometheus and Grafana run as pods within the same EKS cluster.
No specific region or instance sizes were provided.
